reason: B is identical to A plus the Northrop Grumman Innovation Lab role, and no bullet was cut, so nothing stronger is lost. Its OpenCV (C++) real-time pipeline on drone-mounted microcontrollers is the only C++/real-time evidence outside the IEX order-book project, so C++ looks like more than a single summer project to a hiring engineer, and the Northrop name helps a skimming recruiter. It is a completed role (Jan-Jun 2025), not another concurrent 'Present' one, so it adds history without adding to the overlap concern.
risk_noted: The 74% detection accuracy is a weak, unbenchmarked metric with no latency or throughput figure, which is what an HFT reader would care about. A skeptic may question running an OpenCV C++ pipeline 'in real time on microcontrollers' and read 'Innovation Lab' as a student program rather than a Northrop internship. Defense/robotics vision is also off-target for trading systems and makes the page a little denser next to the four existing Present roles.
